slides.heading: VERTICAL COMPOSITION
slides.subheading: Compose for 9:16 delivery from day one

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Shooting 16:9 but delivering 9:16 requires planning the crop.
Place subjects on the center third—never the edges.
Vertical safe area keeps faces and text visible on mobile.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Enable vertical safe-area guides on monitor or app.
Place subject on center third for 9:16 crop.
Keep faces and titles inside the safe zone.
Shoot native vertical when the platform is vertical-first.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Frame for the crop before you roll—fixing in post costs resolution.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Placing subjects on the edge of a horizontal frame you plan to crop.
